newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 down on budget woes, Dow drop.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 down on budget woes, Dow drop.

text.p: The UK's benchmark FTSE 100 share index registered its biggest one-day drop in 2-1/2 months as worries about the contents of the UK budget preoccupied investors, dealers and strategists said.
A shakey start on Wall Street, amid weakening global bond markets, helped fuel the downward spiral that saw the FTSE 100 fall as low as 4,669.1 at one stage.
The blue chip index finished at 4,682.2, down 62.9 points, after losing 38.0 points on Monday.
FTSE 100 decliners broadly beat advancers by an eight to one majority, with UK bank shares taking the biggest hit.
